meaning.en: If someone or something is back to square one, an earlier attempt has failed or previous progress has been lost, so the work must begin again from the starting point.

register.summaryEn: frustration; disappointment; resignation; warning; determination to begin again.

register.formalEn: In highly formal legal, technical or academic writing, expressions such as return to the starting point, restart the process or begin the work again may sometimes be clearer.
register.formalZh: 這四個字必須按照原有次序使用。

examples.zh: 團隊又要重新從頭開始了。

specificForms.formula: Subject + be not + back to square one.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Not every error destroys all progress. The negative form helps learners distinguish a full restart from a limited correction.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 並非每個錯誤都會令所有進展消失。 否定形式有助學生區分「完全重做」與「局部修改」。

examples.en: The project is not back to square one; only one part needs changing.
examples.zh: 這個項目並非回到原點；只有一個部分需要修改。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式十：選擇性情境延伸
specificForms.descriptionEn: Both sentences are grammatically complete. The extension merely identifies the affected process or explains the cause.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 兩個句子在文法上都完整。 延伸部分只是指出受影響的過程或解釋原因，並不是固定慣用語的一部分。

examples.en: We are back to square one.

examples.zh: 由於測試失敗，我們的應用程式工作回到原點。

benefits.zh: 這個計劃令我們回到原點。 這個慣用語把失敗、失去進展和需要重做三個意思濃縮在一個簡潔的表達之中。

examples.en: We are back to square one with the plan.

examples.en: We are back to square one with the design.
examples.zh: 這個設計令我們回到原點。

benefits.zh: 現在我們又回到原點了。

benefits.titleEn: It Explains Cause and Result Efficiently
benefits.en: It Explains Cause and Result Efficiently
benefits.zh: 遺失的檔案令我們回到原點。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful for Warnings and Predictions
benefits.en: It Is Useful for Warnings and Predictions
benefits.zh: 如果我們不儲存副本，一次電腦故障便可能令我們回到原點。

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Learners Distinguish Restarting from Revising

benefits.en: It Helps Learners Distinguish Restarting from Revising
benefits.zh: 並非每個問題都表示要回到原點。

origin.statusEn: Exact Origin Uncertain; Early Board-Game Connection
origin.statusZh: 確切來源不明；早期記錄與棋盤遊戲有關

history.en: The exact origin has not been proved. A widely cited early written example appeared in a 1952 review in The Economic Journal. The writer compared a reader repeatedly losing progress with being returned to square one in a game of snakes and ladders. This is strong early evidence of a board-game association, but it does not prove that one particular game created the expression. 證實。一個經常被引用的早期書面例子出現在1952年的《經濟學期刊》書評中。作者 把讀者反覆失去進展的情況,比作在蛇梯棋中被送回第一格。這是表達與棋盤遊戲有關的有力早 期證據,但不能證明它一定由某一種遊戲創造。

Whether the image came from a particular board game or developed more generally from numbered squares, the logic is clear: progress has been made, something sends the person back to the first position, and the journey must begin again.
history.zh: 不論這個畫面來自某一種棋盤遊戲，還是由編號方格的一般概念逐漸形成，當中的邏輯都十分清楚：一個人原本已取得進展，但某件事令他回到第一個位置，整個過程只好重新開始。

origin.memoryEn: You moved across the board, but one setback sent you back to the first square.
origin.memoryZh: 你原本已在棋盤上向前移動，但一次挫折把你送回第一格。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：之前必須已有進展
rules.zh: 我們幾乎完成了報告，但檔案被刪除了。 我們回到了原點。 今天是我們第一天開始報告，所以我們回到了原點。

examples.en: We had nearly finished the report, but the file was deleted. We are back to square one.
examples.zh: 我們幾乎完成了報告，但檔案被刪除了。我們回到了原點。

examples.en: Today is our first day on the report, so we are back to square one.
examples.zh: 今天是我們第一天開始報告，所以我們回到了原點。

rules.titleEn: The Setback Must Be Major Enough
rules.titleZh: 規則二：挫折必須嚴重得足以令工作重做
rules.en: Every page of the report was lost. One comma in the report is wrong.
rules.zh: 報告的每一頁都遺失了。 團隊回到原點了。 報告中有一個逗號用錯了。

examples.en: The team is back to square one.
examples.zh: 團隊回到原點了。

rules.titleZh: 規則三：保留時態及確定程度
rules.en: Do not change could put into put. That would turn a possibility into a completed fact.
rules.zh: 新規則可能令我們回到原點。 不要把 could put 改成 put，否則會把可能性變成已發生的事實。

examples.en: The new rule could put us back to square one.
examples.zh: 新規則可能令我們回到原點。

rules.titleZh: 規則四：保留受影響的過程
rules.en: The family lost its only hotel booking and had to begin its search again.
rules.zh: 這個家庭失去了唯一的酒店預訂，因此必須重新尋找酒店。 這個家庭回到了原點。 這個家庭尋找酒店的工作回到了原點。

examples.en: The family was back to square one.
examples.zh: 這個家庭回到了原點。

examples.en: The family was back to square one in its search for a hotel.
examples.zh: 這個家庭尋找酒店的工作回到了原點。

rules.titleZh: 規則五：不要重複慣用語已表達的意思
rules.zh: 我們回到原點，所以必須把一切重新從頭開始。 這個項目令我們回到原點。

examples.en: We are back to square one, so we have to begin everything again from the beginning.
examples.zh: 我們回到原點，所以必須把一切重新從頭開始。

examples.en: We are back to square one with the project.
examples.zh: 這個項目令我們回到原點。

rules.titleZh: 規則六：square one 必須使用單數
rules.zh: square one 必須使用單數

rules.titleZh: 規則八：from square one 的意思不同
rules.en: We built the website from square one. This says that the work began from the earliest stage. It does not necessarily say that an earlier attempt failed.
rules.zh: 我們從頭建立這個網站。 這表示工作由最初階段開始，未必表示先前的嘗試失敗。

rules.titleEn: “Back at Square One” Is Not This Exercise’s Target
rules.en: Back at square one is used naturally in English, but this set trains one exact target. Do not replace to with at in the answers.
rules.zh: back at square one 不是本練習的目標 back at square one 在英語中屬於自然用法，但本練習只訓練一個確切形式。 答案中不可把 to 改成 at。

rules.titleZh: 規則十：程度副詞屬於選擇性成分
rules.en: The modifiers change the emphasis but are not part of the fixed target.
rules.zh: 這些副詞會改變強調程度，但並不是固定表達的一部分。

rules.titleEn: Use It for the Same Process
rules.titleZh: 規則十一：必須是同一個過程重新開始
rules.en: The first design failed, so we must redesign the same product. The first project ended successfully, and tomorrow we will begin a different project.
rules.zh: 第一個設計失敗，因此我們必須重新設計同一件產品。 這件產品的設計工作回到原點。 第一個項目成功完成，明天我們會開始另一個項目。

examples.en: We are back to square one with the product.
examples.zh: 這件產品的設計工作回到原點。

rules.titleEn: Use It Naturally, Not for Every Restart
rules.titleZh: 規則十二：自然使用，不是每次重新開始都適合
rules.en: Back to square one usually carries the idea of lost progress, failure or serious frustration. For a normal planned restart, start again or repeat may be more suitable.
rules.zh: back to square one 通常帶有失去進展、失敗或嚴重挫折的意思。 若只是按照計劃正常重做，使用 start again 或 repeat 可能更合適。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using back to square one.
instructions.zh: 使用 back to square one 改寫句子或完成回應。
